mapper.insert: insert into ohfifthlane.disabled_person_report_tbl(user_id, disabled_person_report_image, disabled_person_report_time, disabled_person_report_status, disabled_person_report_lat, disabled_person_report_lon, disabled_person_report_car_number, disabled_person_report_address) values (#{userId}, #{disabledPersonReportImage}, #{disabledPersonReportTime}, #{disabledPersonReportStatus}, #{disabledPersonReportLat}, #{disabledPersonReportLon}, #{disabledPersonReportCarNumber}, #{disabledPersonReportAddress})
mapper.select: select dprtbl.disabled_person_report_id, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_image, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_time, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_status, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_lat, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_lon, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_address, dprtbl.disabled_person_report_car_number, utbl.user_name, utbl.user_tel from ohfifthlane.disabled_person_report_tbl dprtbl join ohfifthlane.user_tbl utbl on dprtbl.user_id = utbl.user_id where dprtbl.disabled_person_report_id = #{disabledPersonReportId}
